final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN CAST(t.amount AS REAL) WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -CAST(t.amount AS REAL) END) as account_avg FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_avg) as freq_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY frequency) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.account_avg, CASE WHEN fa.freq_avg IS NOT NULL AND fa.freq_avg != 0 THEN aa.account_avg / fa.freq_avg END as ratio FROM account_averages aa LEFT JOIN frequency_averages fa ON aa.frequency = fa.frequency ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
